# UAE Ministry of Education Digital Accessibility Policy

Official source: https://www.moe.gov.ae/en/digital-participation/policies/pages/digital-accessibility-policy.aspx

Source type: agency policy. Original official text must be captured and source-checked before transcribing in full. This Markdown is a paraphrased source record, not the original legal text.

## Reported topics

Agency states minimum WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 Level AA, describes audits and feedback, and acknowledges legacy-content limitations. Its statement is not an independent audit or a general requirement on every UAE organization.
